The bowl looks like a paper bowl about 15-16 cm across. It holds a heaped pile of almonds. Each almond is roughly 2.2 cm long and weighs about 1.2 g. The pile fills most of the bowl and is about 2-3 layers deep. I count about 60 almonds on the visible surface and estimate about 100 in total, which gives roughly 120 g. The bowl is about 15 cm across, so the pile's footprint is about 12 cm across. A cylinder of that footprint at 3 cm tall has a volume of roughly 340 ml. Almonds pack at about 0.6 g/ml with air gaps, which gives roughly 200 g. Taking the two estimates together, I settle on about 150 g.
